Level 2 - Beginner 30 min LLD UML AmazonWalmart

Class Diagrams

A class diagram is the one picture every LLD round expects: boxes for classes, lines for how they relate. After this page you can read and draw one fluently - visibility, types, abstract classes, interfaces, enums, multiplicity - turn it into Java, Python or C++, and know how much of it to draw before the interviewer wants code.
